rate_selection: Exact requested model label, used as a pricing proxy only; no served-model identity claim.

usage_semantics.cached_input: Subset of input_tokens; never add again to token total.
usage_semantics.cache_write: Subset of input_tokens, priced instead of ordinary input; not an additive fee.
usage_semantics.reasoning_output: Subset of output_tokens; never add again.
usage_semantics.missing_cache_write: Strict API equivalent remains null. Scenarios explicitly assume zero unreported cache writes, with separate all-noncached-write scenario endpoint.
usage_semantics.multi_turn_context: Aggregate CLI input can exceed272K across turns without any individual API request crossing threshold. Never infer context tier from aggregate turn totals.

unknown_policy.cache_read: null scenario if missing or invalid
unknown_policy.cache_write: null strict equivalent; explicit scenario assumptions only

billing_basis: Reference Standard API token scenarios only. Codex ChatGPT subscription allocation, effective service tier, region, per-request context and served identity are not established by CLI usage.
